title: Shamwari Yakatendeuka
intro: Wava kuda kuburitsa nyaya yemweya waigara mumumvuri weuporofita asi wakasarudza nzira yaienda kukuparadzwa. Munhu uyu aigara musha nemumwe wevatumwa vakasarudzwa naAllah asi akakundikana muedzo wekutenda. Ndiani shamwari iyi yakarasika?
clues: Ndakagara pakati pevanhu vakaramba kudanwa kwekururama, uye handina kuvapikisa.
Ndakanga ndakaroorwa nemuporofita waAllah, asi ndaisatendawo izvozvo.
Nhume padzakauya kumba kwangu dzichindinyevera, handina kuzvitenda.
Mudzimai wangu akarayirwa kuti abve muguta pamwe chete nevatendi, uye ini ndakanga ndisiri pakati pavo.
Kurangwa kwakawira vanhu vangu, uye ndakaparadzwa pamwe chete navo.
Ndakataurwa muQuran semuenzaniso wekusatenda, pamwe chete nemukadzi waNuh, muSurah At-Tahrim.
arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
